The Frozen East

Level 4 · Diplomacy · New Targonor · Thestra

Objectives

Find Grom Vermach in Halgarad for more work.

What they say

On taking it

Investigator Trenkle
"You've done well with our troubles here," he says, "but yhere is much more to be do on Threstra." "I have heard of a problem in Halgarad that may be part of the larger picture here. If you's like the work, go see Grom Vermach in the tavern in Halgarad. I'll mark your map so you can find him easier."

Recorded by wiki.silkyvenom.com.

Notes

Grom Vermach is at The Stone Mug Tavern in Halgarad. Starting locations: Investigator Trenkle in Tursh Village War Master Trabrand Silvereye in Bordinar's Cleft Preceptor Indrandi in Leth Nurae

findings.observation: The Frozen East heading labels Level 4 Diplomacy, New Targonor, Thestra. Objective directs the player to Grom Vermach in Halgarad; Notes specifies The Stone Mug Tavern. Heading and destination remain separate contexts; no coordinates or spawn verification are supplied.

The Frozen East Details says Starts with Varies. Notes lists Investigator Trenkle in Tursh Village, War Master Trabrand Silvereye in Bordinars Cleft, and Preceptor Indrandi in Leth Nurae. Taking dialogue is attributed to Investigator Trenkle and wiki.silkyvenom.com. One starts-npc disagreement is attributed to wiki.silkyvenom.com:80 without an alternate value. Preserve all role accounts without choosing a canonical starter.

The Forest Home heading labels Level 4 Diplomacy, Tursh, Thestra and a house-relative direction. Objective and Description direct the player to Preceptor Indradi in Leth Nurae; Notes places Indradi in the Order of the Azure Flame building. These are distinct starter and destination contexts; no exact spawn is established.

The Forest Home Details starts with Investigator Trenkle; Notes also lists War Master Trabrand Silvereye in Bordinars Cleft as a starting location. Dialogue is attributed to Investigator Trenkle and wiki.silkyvenom.com. Do not collapse alternative starting roles or infer a completion script. Frozen East spells its Leth Nurae starter Indrandi while Forest Home spells its destination Indradi; identity matching remains unresolved.

Both pages give Previous as An Assassins Orders or Party Crasher or Revenge of the Rat. Frozen East Next is A Bad Equation For Murder; Forest Home Next is Flight Of The Griffon. The preceding Mountains Base review lists both pages as Next. Navigation observations do not establish enforced prerequisites or branch exclusivity. Exact punctuation is retained in article markup.
Both pages label Repeatable yes and Coin reward 25 without denomination or repeatability conditions. Retain observations without constructing operative reward values.

Frozen East links thetelonproject.wikidot.com as its source; Forest Home links vanguard.fandom.com. Both taking-dialogue accounts credit wiki.silkyvenom.com. Linked originals were not fetched during this cache-only review; archived mirror provenance is not independent corroboration.
